messages:
maya: Quick thread to pick defaults for private deploy networking and upgrade behavior. Need final answers today: default mode, upgrade strategy, telemetry default, and a short customer comms blurb.

lucas: Proposal: default = operator + relay (lowest lift). Offer NAT mode for egress IP needs. BGP = enterprise opt-in with SE handoff.

ria: Agreed. For upgrades default to rolling canary (3% traffic, 10m), abort on smoke failure. Blue/green only documented as an advanced pattern.

owen: Telemetry: default OFF for private deployments; provide `redwoodctl telemetry consent --scopes=errors,perf` and produce a signed audit token when enabled.

maya: Nice. Also need a one-paragraph maintenance window template for customers. Draft: "Planned upgrades aim for minimal disruption; typical rolling upgrade time is 15-60 minutes. Network-affecting changes (BGP cutover) may require scheduled coordination"

lucas: Preflight checklist items to include in installer: firewall ports, MTU check, nftables vs iptables, LB SNAT detection, and DNS records pointing to egress IPs. Add `--preflight-only --output=json` to `redwoodctl`.

ria: Action items: Lucas -> preflight checklist + BGP sample (Wed), Owen -> telemetry CLI spec (Tue), Maya -> one-page decision flow for SEs (Tue). I'll assemble RFC after that.

ops-bot: Created ticket PD-7001 "private-deploy network defaults & rollout" and assigned to @maya, @lucas, @ria, @owen.
thread_text_summary: Short decision thread: operator+relay default, NAT for egress, BGP as enterprise opt-in; rolling canary upgrades (3%/10m); telemetry default OFF; preflight checklist and action owners assigned
